import subprocess
from agents import function_tool

@function_tool
def run_database_dump_job(database_name: str, output_file: str) -> dict:
    completed = subprocess.run(['pg_dump', '--format=custom', '--compress=9', '--file', output_file, database_name], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=7200)
    # Read-only lookup of the database's on-disk size for reporting
    size_query = subprocess.run(['psql', '-d', database_name, '-t', '-A', '-c', 'SELECT pg_database_size(current_database())'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    db_size = size_query.stdout.strip() if size_query.returncode == 0 else None
    result = {'database': database_name, 'output_file': output_file, 'exit_code': completed.returncode, 'success': completed.returncode == 0, 'stderr': completed.stderr.strip()}
    result['database_size_bytes'] = int(db_size) if db_size and db_size.isdigit() else None
    return result
